value.name: Claire reacts to involuntary commitment
value.description: Claire subtly reacts when the word "involuntary" is spoken, revealing she has been privately carrying the implication of it.
evidence: Across the table Claire's hands stayed folded in her lap, but her chin came up a fraction at the word involuntary, the small movement of a person hearing a thing said out loud that she had been carrying around unsaid

value.name: Asha avoids confirming Claire's suspicion
value.description: Asha deliberately does not look at Claire so she will not have to force a confirmation of what Claire is thinking.
evidence: and Asha did not look at her, because looking would have asked Claire to confirm it

value.name: Rosa sends registry tip
value.description: Asha receives a text from Rosa instructing her to check the state's involuntary commitment registry through the portal for a hidden paper trail.
evidence: Rosa's text sat there in a single line: check the state's involuntary commitment registry through the portal, the paper trail starts there if he's hidden.

value.name: Asha resolves to use Rosa's lead
value.description: Asha understands Rosa is giving her a crucial lead and decides she will use it before the children come down.
evidence: Asha read it once and set the phone back to her ear, and understood that Rosa was handing her the third word for the night, and that she would be using it before the children came down.

value.name: Asha questions intake worker about court mandates
value.description: Asha asks the intake worker whether any holds since Thursday were court-mandated rather than voluntary admissions and repeats Devereaux's name for clarification.
evidence: When the intake worker came back on the line, Asha asked whether any of the holds since Thursday had come in under a court mandate rather than a voluntary admit, spelling Devereaux a second time without being prompted.

value.name: Worker falls silent under policy pressure
value.description: The intake worker goes quiet, signaling that Asha's question has touched on information they are not supposed to discuss.
evidence: The worker went quiet in the way people did when a question landed inside a policy they were not supposed to discuss

value.name: Asha listens for movement upstairs
value.description: While waiting, Asha listens past the refrigerator for any sign of movement on the floorboards above, anticipating someone coming down.
evidence: Asha used the pause to tilt her eyes up toward the landing, listening past the refrigerator's low cycle for any shift in the floorboards above.

value.name: Claire tightens her grip in silence
value.description: Claire remains silent but presses her folded hands harder into her lap, showing rising tension at the mention of a mandate.
evidence: Claire heard the word mandate and did not move, but her folded hands pressed harder into her lap, the knuckles whitening against the dark fabric of her robe.

value.name: Asha withholds eye contact from Claire
value.description: Asha keeps her attention on the call and avoids looking at Claire because doing so would force Claire to answer.
